title: Doctor's Orders
description: Zakariya of Bimarstan is taking great pains to help his patients.

mainQuestExcel.title: Doctor's Orders
mainQuestExcel.description: Zakariya of Bimarstan is taking great pains to help his patients.

dialogs.text: *sigh* What a headache...
Do you need a hand with anything?
We have been really shorthanded lately, and I haven't slept for days on end.
If you would, Traveler, could you help me deliver some medicine to the patients nearby? Please check on them as well.
Leave it to me.
I'm counting on you. For the Dendro Archon's sake, I could really use a helper capable of saying something other than saying "Dendro Archon bless you."
Hah, "For the Dendro Archon's sake"... I've been saying that a lot lately, haven't I?
You should take a break.
I'm afraid I simply cannot. I have placed patients with more serious conditions elsewhere, and I have to prepare medicines for them.
*sigh* They will definitely ask me how they might embrace the blessings of the Dendro Archon.
I am counting on you. I could really use an assistant capable of something other than talking about the blessings of the Dendro Archon...
What's happened here?
You must be a traveler. This is Bimarstan, a hospital that aids the masses... Um... by spreading the blessings of the Dendro Archon.
No matter rich or poor, anyone in need shall get medical help here.
But as a result... We have too many patients and not enough hands to see to them all.
*sigh* The benevolence of the Dendro Archon might be endless... But our budget and manpower are not.
And then there are patients who ignore all medical instructions, but just keep asking about how to better embrace the blessings of the Dendro Archon.
Haha, blessings of the Dendro Archon... My goodness!
If the Dendro Archon really could just rain down blessings, they wouldn't have gotten sick in the first place!
...Phew, sorry, I shouldn't have said that. Please don't tell Golshan about this, or she might lecture me again.
Aren't you a pious believer of the Dendro Archon?
Of course I am. Can you find someone in Sumeru City who isn't?
But you can leave "piousness" out of this. I would consider myself a rather... rational believer in the Dendro Archon.
Ugh... Sorry, I must be too tired out. I was just venting. Please don't take what I said too seriously.
Some say that treatment itself is the blessing of the Dendro Archon...
*sigh* But just consider these stories, alright? Don't be so serious about it like some of our patients.
If the Dendro Archon were as mighty as the legends claim, I would only need to feed people some mushrooms, and bam, they would be healed.
The medicine delivery this time is for Gurgen, who is at the medicine farm.
He strained his arm from doing too much work a few days before.
Please give him this medicine. By the way, tell him to also stay at home and pray silently to the Dendro Archon. Farm work can wait.
Sure.
Please come back once the delivery is done. I will have the payment ready for you.
Pray silently to the Dendro Archon?
He won't listen to a word I say if I don't say that. Just do as I instructed, alright?
I'm counting on you for the medicine delivery. Don't forget to pass the medical instructions on either.
If I stop tending to the field for too many days, the weeds are going to grow...
Huh? This is...
Here's your medicine, remember to pray quietly to the Dendro Archon.
Ah, thanks. Pray quietly to the Dendro Archon... Yes, I must do that...
But there are so many <color=#00E1FFFF>weeds in the field</color>... If I keep doing nothing, it's going to affect the yield.
Um... I'll just <color=#00E1FFFF>deal with the weeds</color> first, then do my silent prayers when I finish.
I'm counting on you for the medicine delivery. Don't forget to pass the medical instructions on either.
*sigh* I guess my body isn't what it used to be... No, I can't give up yet. I must persist for a while more.
You're back. How did it go?
He wanted to deal with the weeds first...
*sigh* So even the silent prayer line didn't work... I suppose I'll have to come up with something else.
Thanks for your hard work. Please, take this as payment.
*sigh* I guess my body isn't what it used to be... No, I can't give up yet. I must persist for a while more.
The weeds... You've removed them all? I... You're too kind!
Just go back home and rest.
I will, thank you. May the Dendro Archon bless and protect you!
I should hurry home to conduct my silent prayers to the Dendro Archon as well.
I'm counting on you for the medicine delivery. Don't forget to pass the medical instructions on either.
You are back. How did it go?
About removing the weeds...
Ah, that's great. This way, Gurgen can finally have some proper rest. He should be able to recover sooner.
I can't thank you enough. Please take this as your payment.
The medicine this time is for Azra at the theater entrance.
She has been coughing lately, but she refused to take the medicine I prescribed, saying that it tastes too bitter.
Please give her this medicine. Also, tell her that... Um...
This... bitterness in the medicine is but a... test, yes, a test, bestowed by the Dendro Archon.
Sure I will.
Please come back once the delivery is done. I will have the payment ready for you.
Where did you learn this stuff?
I didn't exactly learn it? I've just heard these kinds of things too often.
I'm counting on you for the medicine delivery. Don't forget to pass the medical instructions on either.
*sigh* Day after day, I guard this door. When will I get to take a look inside?
Hmm... This smells familiar...
Here's your medicine. Remember to finish all of it...
Ugh, this <color=#00E1FFFF>super bitter medicine</color> again. I can't take it...
This is but a test from the Dendro Archon, you know?
Eh? Is that so? But <color=#00E1FFFF>it's so bitter</color>... Can't the Dendro Archon be just a wee bit nicer?
...Alright, alright, hand me the medicine. I'll take it later...
I'm counting on you for the medicine delivery. Don't forget to pass the medical instructions on either.
You're back. How did it go?
She complained that the medicine was too bitter.
Well, there's nothing I can do about that. After all, the nature and components of the herbs... Ahem, I mean blessings, come with some bitterness.
Hopefully, she will finish it all this time. There was so much left over previously...
Thanks for your hard work. Please take this as payment.
I'm counting on you for the medicine delivery. Don't forget to pass the medical instructions on either.
Ugh, this is too bitter for anyone to swallow. How am I supposed to take it all?
Eh? Are these for me? Thank you...
Alright! I'll give the medicine another go... I'll finish it all for sure this time!
You're back. How did it go?
I gave her some candies.
Candies? They'll reduce the efficacy of that medicine, though.
...Ah, never mind. Reduced efficacy is better than no efficacy at all, and at least she can finish the medicine this time around.
I really can't thank you enough. Please take this as payment.
The medicine delivery this time is for Aftab at the farmhouse.
That fellow's been living on a greasy diet, so he has serious digestion problems.
So please give him this medicine. By the way, tell him that... Um...
Tell him that eating lighter foods and having less alcohol and meat is the way to better embrace the blessings of the Dendro Archon.
Sure.
Please come back once the delivery is done. I will have the payment ready for you.
Where on earth did you hear such things?
Some Akademiya researchers have said that we can do something like that, though I don't understand why...
I'm counting on you for the medicine delivery. Don't forget to pass the medical instructions on either.
I just need to hold on for a few days more...
Hmm? What is this medicine?
Here's your medicine. Please maintain a light diet.
*sigh* Okay, I will. Honestly, I <color=#00E1FFFF>haven't touched a slice of meat</color> in days. I'm sure that this will definitely help me to embrace the Dendro Archon's blessings better...
But why do I feel worse than before? *sigh* No, no, I must've just spent too little time dieting, that's all...
I'm counting on you for the medicine delivery. Don't forget to pass the medical instructions on either.
You're back. How did it go?
He has kept away from meat for quite a few days now...
What? I was telling him to eat lighter, not to completely stop eating meat!
Does he think that he can best embrace the Dendro Archon's blessings this way?
Alright... I guess I have to come up with something else...
Thanks for your hard work. Here, this is for you.
I just need to hold on for several days more...
I'm counting on you for the medicine delivery. Don't forget to pass the medical instructions on either.
What is this? No... The scent is just too...
So here's what happened...
Really? A light diet doesn't mean a full ban on meat? Even the Akademiya researchers don't do that?
S—So that's it! I was afraid of making the Dendro Archon angry by eating meat.
If even the researchers do eat meat... I won't worry about eating meat anymore. Thank you!
I'm counting on you for the medicine delivery. Don't forget to pass the medical instructions on either.
You're back. How did it go?
I told him that he could just eat a steak or two...
Oh? It didn't occur to me you could put it like that...
Well, as long as Aftab is treating his body right, everything should be fine.
I can't thank you enough. Please take this as your payment.
